tools.name: get_page_summary
tools.description: Return the current page's URL, title, meta description and main headings.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: Enumerate the forms on the current page and their fields, so they can be filled and submitted with submit_form.

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Navigate to a path on this site (e.g. /products, /contact, /cart).

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search this website for a query and open the results page.

tools.name: submit_form
tools.description: Fill a form on this page (matched by index from list_forms) with the given field values and submit it.

fields.description: Map of field name → value to fill before submitting
